changes: Added a Parallel Wave Integration section to Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md and refined it through reviewer feedback so frozen Parallel Development snapshots use full-envelope Wave artifacts only.
usage: Open Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md and read the Parallel Wave Integration section after Relationship To Existing Concepts to see how Wave planning composes with Parallel Development execution coordination.
expectedOutcome: The user sees the agreed integration model written into the document: Parallel Wave plans, Parallel Development coordinates execution, and proof remains in story/review/validation/receipt/claim gates.
actualTranscript: sed -n 124,205p Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md showed the new Parallel Wave Integration section. lattice parallel_wave_create --format=json showed schemaVersion/generatedAt, full-envelope fields, and non-authoritative authority fields; lattice validate --story=B-7110 passed via npm test.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. Reviewers caught and the final document corrected two edge details: projection-only parallel_report is summary-only, and parallel_wave_create uses schemaVersion/generatedAt while inspect/plan expose waveSchemaVersion.
limitations: The document remains an execution plan and capability definition; it does not claim that parallel_development_* runtime execution surfaces already exist.
pitfalls: Do not treat Parallel Wave output as authority evidence or use projection-only reports as frozen snapshot binding artifacts.
